body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Delphi presented ''NAV200'', its new 3.5-inch portable navigation system during CES 2007. It features 400MHz processor and SD card slot for multimedia contents.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
